name: qfd_c_land_w257_narrow-safe1-COMMIT
purpose: hard landing half; critical CB16 parent prerequisite, gate only

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_c_land_w257_narrow u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/qcluster/qfd_c_land_safe.sv rtl/physical/qcluster/qfd_c_land.sv rtl/test/tb_qfd_c_land_safe.sv tools/qwen_cluster/bench_land_safe.sh && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_land_w257_narrow/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_land_w257_narrow/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_land_w257_narrow --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_c_land_w257_narrow  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: SAFE-QW-CB16: replace 163k soft parent DFFs with <=258bit ring/read hard halves, kept per24bit rotating onehot selects and 2stage reset. Geometry pin limited; parent not yet bound. Narrow variant: split bank_w/bank_e across W/E faces; 516/128.52=4.02pins/um; 258/63.72=4.05 on N. 64.8x129.6, aspect2.
